known_gaps: VwapReversion has no paper or live adapter: the attestation covers the backtest mode only.

Breakout: the backtest engine does not model the TP ladder (scored on TP1), same-day re-entry cycles or the day-type counter-bias veto, so what is simulated is narrower than live although the same code decides signals.
EmaVwapEarly: the initial stop is the engine stop in the backtest and a broker SL-M live; the exit fills at the next open in the backtest and as a market order live.
The entry and exit execution of the live executor was not reviewed or changed.

modes.Breakout: backtest adapter wraps the live pipeline BreakoutStrategy and strategy_core.breakout; paper and live call the same core
modes.EmaVwapEarly: backtest adapter and pipeline adapter call strategy_core.ema_vwap_early; the trailing stop is stepped by the core's TrailState in both (backtest custom_exit, live pipeline/trail_driver)
modes.VwapReversion: backtest adapter only; no paper or live adapter exists in pipeline/strategies

evidence.not_covered: any strategy class not listed in `strategies` (for example ORB, EMA9, the swing strategies): their rules sit inside backtest/strategies and have no shared core, so G0.1 stays not evaluated for them
review_notes: Read the three backtest adapters and the two pipeline adapters in full: each holds state wiring and event relays only; entry, stop, target and trail rules are in strategy_core.

Import audit (test_g01_structure): every strategy_core module imports only strategy_core, features and the clock; no adapter reads the indicator or level modules; exit logic is called from strategy_core.exits and ema_vwap_early by the exit drivers.
VwapReversion's run_overrides set engine execution parameters (entry cutoff, daily trade cap, skip-at-fill, min_sl_pct pinned to the live validator with a drift test), not signal rules.
evidence.reviewer_scope: read-through plus the automated checks above, by a Claude Code session; not countersigned by the repository owner
evidence.scope: G0.1: the strategy rules live in strategy_core; adapters only wire them to each mode
